148.text: the first sweet music , birdlike , abandoned , and the boy

quotes.text:
"Well, I reckon you'd be a-feared if you was caught out in
the black dark all alone."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Pooh! I've stayed out all
alone heaps o' nights."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Who's a-feared of the dark? I love night."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"I knows where the sun rises, and
I knows where it sets."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "We'se known us all our lives, and--before, ain't we?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "And we'll be friends always, won't we?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Why, that's where I'm going. I was a-feared it was a long way off; I
must have passed it in the night."
quotes.speaker: Unknown
